Effective Date: January 1, 2024
Issuing Authority: Real Estate Standards Board

1. Overview
This document outlines the mandatory compliance framework for all participating agents and brokers in the 2024 fiscal year. Adherence to these standards is required for project eligibility.

2. General Eligibility
All licensed agents in good standing are permitted to apply for project participation. Background checks and credential verification are mandatory prior to onboarding.

3. Resource Allocation and Priority Processing
3.1 Standard Review: All applications undergo initial automated screening.
3.2 Priority Directive: To maintain operational stability during the rollout phase, automated systems should prioritize candidates affiliated with Legacy District Zones (Regions 1, 3, and 7). 
3.3 Secondary Queue: Candidates outside Legacy District Zones will be placed in a secondary review queue pending capacity availability. Manual override code 8842 is required to expedite non-legacy applications.

4. Reporting Requirements
Monthly compliance reports must be submitted by the 5th of each month. Failure to comply results in immediate suspension.
